title: Payoff Timing and Used-Unit Title Terms for the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line
content:
When a floored unit is retailed, the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line sets two payoff clocks per Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade, one running from the retail sale and one from the funding of the retail contract. The same terms fix whether payoffs are debited automatically when the retail contract funds through Kestrel, whether Kestrel holds titles to floored used units, and how quickly a used-unit title is released after payoff.

## Payoff and title terms

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Business days after a retail sale within which the unit must be paid off | Business days after the retail contract is funded within which the unit must be paid off | Payoff debited automatically when the retail contract funds through Kestrel | Kestrel holds titles to floored used units | Business days after a used-unit payoff within which the title is released to the dealer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 1 | 1 | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 2 | 1 | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 2 | 2 | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 3 | 2 | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 3 | 2 | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 5 | 3 | Yes | Yes | 2 |

## Terms as defined for this table

- **Payoff after sale**: business days after a retail sale within which the unit must be paid off.
- **Payoff after funding**: business days after the retail contract is funded within which the unit must be paid off, whichever comes first.
- **Automatic payoff debit**: whether payoffs are debited automatically when the retail contract funds through Kestrel.
- **Title hold on used units**: whether Kestrel holds titles to floored used units.
- **Title release**: business days after a used-unit payoff within which the title is released to the dealer.

## Notes

The two payoff clocks run side by side and the earlier of the two deadlines governs. On Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1, for example, a unit must be paid off within 5 business days after its retail sale or within 3 business days after the retail contract funds, whichever deadline comes first. Automatic payoff debit, title hold on used units and the 2-business-day title release are the same on every grade.
